lessons.name: The Education System
lessons.description: From kindergarten to the final exams, and the Bulgarian grading scale.

multiple_choice.name: Match the school stages
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English phrase to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Starting school at seven
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Децата __ на училище на седем години.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Децата тръгват на училище на седем години." means "Children start school at the age of seven."

true_false.name: True or false: Ezikova gimnaziya
true_false.sentence: An "езикова гимназия" is a secondary school with intensive foreign language teaching.
true_false.explanation: Correct. Pupils often spend their first year learning a language almost full time.

fill_in_the_blank.name: They take the final exams
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: След дванадесети клас учениците __ матури.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "След дванадесети клас учениците държат матури." means "After twelfth grade, pupils take their final exams." You "hold" an exam: държа изпит.

fill_in_the_blank.name: In ninth grade
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Сестра ми е в девети __ в езикова гимназия.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Сестра ми е в девети клас в езикова гимназия." means "My sister is in ninth grade at a language school."

true_false.name: True or false: Mark 2
true_false.sentence: In Bulgaria a mark of 2 is the best possible grade.
true_false.explanation: Marks run from 2 to 6: 2 is a fail and 6 is excellent.

multiple_choice.name: Match the school subjects
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each subject to its Bulgarian name.

fill_in_the_blank.name: My favourite subject
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Любимият ми __ е историята.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Любимият ми предмет е историята." means "My favourite subject is history."

true_false.name: True or false: Detska gradina
true_false.sentence: "Детска градина" is a kindergarten.
true_false.explanation: Correct. Literally, "children's garden", just like the German Kindergarten.

fill_in_the_blank.name: If I had been better at maths
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Ако __ по-добър по математика, щях да стана инженер.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Ако бях по-добър по математика, щях да стана инженер." means "If I had been better at maths, I would have become an engineer."

lessons.name: University Life
lessons.description: Lectures, halls of residence and degrees.

multiple_choice.name: Match the university words
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English word to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: The lecture starts at nine
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Лекцията __ в девет часа в зала 5.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Лекцията започва в девет часа в зала 5." means "The lecture starts at nine in room 5."

true_false.name: True or false: Sofia University
true_false.sentence: Sofia University "St Kliment Ohridski" is the oldest university in Bulgaria.
true_false.explanation: Correct. It was founded in 1888.

fill_in_the_blank.name: When I was a student
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Докато __ студент, живеех в общежитие.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Докато бях студент, живеех в общежитие." means "While I was a student, I lived in a hall of residence."

fill_in_the_blank.name: A scholarship for top marks
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Получавам __ за отличен успех.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Получавам стипендия за отличен успех." means "I get a scholarship for excellent results."

true_false.name: True or false: Obshtezhitie
true_false.sentence: "Общежитие" is a lecture hall.
true_false.explanation: An общежитие is a hall of residence. A lecture hall is an "аудитория".

multiple_choice.name: Match the degree words
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English word to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: In the Faculty of Law
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Той е студент в Юридическия __ на Софийския университет.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Той е студент в Юридическия факултет..." means "He is a student in the Faculty of Law..." The article already sits on the adjective.

true_false.name: True or false: Four years
true_false.sentence: In Bulgaria a bachelor's degree usually takes four years.
true_false.explanation: Correct. A master's degree usually takes one or two more.

fill_in_the_blank.name: The exam will be on Wednesday
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Професорът ни каза, че изпитът __ в сряда.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Професорът ни каза, че изпитът ще бъде в сряда." means "The professor told us the exam would be on Wednesday." Bulgarian keeps the original tense in reported speech.

lessons.name: Exams and Grades
lessons.description: Revising, passing, failing and resits, with past unreal conditions.

multiple_choice.name: Match the grades
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each grade to its Bulgarian name.

fill_in_the_blank.name: An excellent six
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Взех изпита с __ шест.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Взех изпита с отличен шест." means "I passed the exam with an excellent six." The grade names are masculine: отличен шест.

true_false.name: True or false: Slab 2
true_false.sentence: In Bulgarian schools, "слаб 2" means you have failed.
true_false.explanation: Correct. You then have to retake the exam.

fill_in_the_blank.name: If you had studied more
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Ако __ повече, щеше да вземеш изпита.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Ако беше учил повече, щеше да вземеш изпита." means "If you had studied more, you would have passed the exam."

fill_in_the_blank.name: Strictly forbidden
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Преписването на изпит е строго __ в университета.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Преписването на изпит е строго забранено в университета." means "Cheating in exams is strictly forbidden at university." Преписването is neuter.

true_false.name: True or false: Prepisvam
true_false.sentence: In an exam, "преписвам" means to study hard.
true_false.explanation: In an exam, "преписвам" means to copy, or cheat.

multiple_choice.name: Match the exam phrases
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English phrase to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: I studied all night
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Цяла нощ __ за изпита и сега съм уморен.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Цяла нощ учих за изпита и сега съм уморен." means "I studied all night for the exam and now I am tired."

true_false.name: True or false: Skasaha me
true_false.sentence: "Скъсаха ме на изпита" means "I failed the exam".
true_false.explanation: Correct. Literally, "They tore me at the exam".

fill_in_the_blank.name: A resit in September
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Трябва да се __ на поправка през септември.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Трябва да се явя на поправка през септември." means "I have to sit a resit in September."

lessons.name: Applying for a Job
lessons.description: Job adverts, cover letters and interview questions.

multiple_choice.name: Match the application words
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English phrase to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: I applied for a position
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Кандидатствах за __ в банка.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Кандидатствах за позиция в банка." means "I applied for a position at a bank."

true_false.name: True or false: Motivatsionno pismo
true_false.sentence: A "мотивационно писмо" is a cover letter sent with a CV.
true_false.explanation: Correct. Literally, "motivation letter".

fill_in_the_blank.name: If they hire me
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Ако ме __ на работа, ще започна от първи октомври.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Ако ме наемат на работа, ще започна от първи октомври." means "If they hire me, I will start on 1 October."

fill_in_the_blank.name: Whether I have experience
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Работодателят ме попита __ имам опит с клиенти.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Работодателят ме попита дали имам опит с клиенти." means "The employer asked me whether I have experience with clients."

true_false.name: True or false: Preporaka
true_false.sentence: "Препоръка" means a job rejection.
true_false.explanation: A препоръка is a recommendation or a reference.

multiple_choice.name: Match the skills
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English phrase to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: I speak English fluently
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Владея английски __ и немски на добро ниво.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Владея английски свободно и немски на добро ниво." means "I speak English fluently and German to a good level."

true_false.name: True or false: Driving licence
true_false.sentence: Bulgarian CVs often mention a driving licence ("шофьорска книжка").
true_false.explanation: Correct. Many job adverts ask for one.

fill_in_the_blank.name: I was invited to an interview
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Бях __ на интервю миналата седмица.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Бях поканен на интервю миналата седмица." means "I was invited to an interview last week."

multiple_choice.name: Match the office words
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English phrase to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: The Sales department
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Работя в __ „Продажби“.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Работя в отдел „Продажби“." means "I work in the Sales department." Before a name the noun takes no article.

true_false.name: True or false: Izvanreden trud
true_false.sentence: "Извънреден труд" means overtime.
true_false.explanation: Correct. Literally, "extraordinary work".

fill_in_the_blank.name: Ready by noon
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Шефът поиска докладът да бъде __ до обяд.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Шефът поиска докладът да бъде готов до обяд." means "The boss wanted the report ready by noon." Доклад is masculine.

fill_in_the_blank.name: While they were in a meeting
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Докато колегите __ на среща, аз пишех имейли.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Докато колегите бяха на среща, аз пишех имейли." means "While my colleagues were in a meeting, I was writing emails."

true_false.name: True or false: Zasedatelna zala
true_false.sentence: A "заседателна зала" is the office kitchen.
true_false.explanation: A заседателна зала is a meeting room.

multiple_choice.name: Match the office tasks
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English phrase to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Print this for me
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Може ли да ми __ този документ?
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Може ли да ми разпечаташ този документ?" means "Could you print this document for me?"

true_false.name: True or false: Lunch break
true_false.sentence: Many Bulgarian offices have a lunch break of about an hour.
true_false.explanation: Correct. It is often called "обедна почивка".

fill_in_the_blank.name: As soon as I finish
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Щом __ отчета, ще ти го изпратя.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Щом завърша отчета, ще ти го изпратя." means "As soon as I finish the report, I will send it to you."

lessons.name: Advertising
lessons.description: Adverts, brands and persuasion, with the conditional and "чиито".

multiple_choice.name: Match the advertising words
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English word to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Shown every evening
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Рекламата __ по телевизията всяка вечер.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Рекламата се показва по телевизията всяка вечер." means "The advert is shown on TV every evening."

true_false.name: True or false: Reklama
true_false.sentence: "Реклама" means an advertisement, while "рекламация" is a complaint.
true_false.explanation: Correct. The two look alike but mean very different things.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Whose products
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Това е марка, __ продукти се продават в цяла Европа.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Това е марка, чиито продукти се продават в цяла Европа." means "This is a brand whose products are sold all over Europe." Чиито agrees with the plural продукти.

fill_in_the_blank.name: More people would watch
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Ако рекламата беше по-кратка, повече хора __ да я гледат.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "...повече хора биха искали да я гледат" means "...more people would want to watch it." An unreal condition takes бих in the main clause.

true_false.name: True or false: Skrita reklama
true_false.sentence: "Скрита реклама" is an advert that is clearly labelled.
true_false.explanation: "Скрита реклама" is hidden advertising, such as product placement.

multiple_choice.name: Match the persuasion verbs
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English verb to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Adverts persuade us
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Рекламите често ни __ да купуваме неща, които не ни трябват.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Рекламите често ни убеждават да купуваме неща, които не ни трябват." means "Adverts often persuade us to buy things we do not need."

true_false.name: True or false: Promotsionalna tsena
true_false.sentence: "Промоционална цена" is a special reduced price.
true_false.explanation: Correct. It is often shortened to "промоция".

fill_in_the_blank.name: I do not trust online ads
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Не вярвам __ рекламите в интернет.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Не вярвам на рекламите в интернет." means "I do not trust adverts on the internet." To trust someone or something is "вярвам на".

lessons.name: The News
lessons.description: Newspapers, headlines and reporting what was said.

multiple_choice.name: Match the news words
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English word to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Watching the news
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Гледам __ всяка вечер в седем.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Гледам новините всяка вечер в седем." means "I watch the news every evening at seven."

true_false.name: True or false: Novini plural
true_false.sentence: In Bulgarian, "новини" (news) is a plural noun.
true_false.explanation: Correct. A single piece of news is "новина".

fill_in_the_blank.name: The minister resigned
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Според вестника министърът __ оставка вчера.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Според вестника министърът подаде оставка вчера." means "According to the newspaper, the minister resigned yesterday." To resign is "подавам оставка".

fill_in_the_blank.name: Whose article won
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Това е журналистката, __ статия спечели наградата.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Това е журналистката, чиято статия спечели наградата." means "This is the journalist whose article won the prize." Чиято agrees with статия.

true_false.name: True or false: Zaglavie
true_false.sentence: A "заглавие" is the last line of a newspaper article.
true_false.explanation: A заглавие is a headline or a title.

multiple_choice.name: Match the media verbs
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English verb to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Published on Sunday
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Статията беше __ в неделния брой.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Статията беше публикувана в неделния брой." means "The article was published in the Sunday edition."

true_false.name: True or false: Na zhivo
true_false.sentence: "Излъчване на живо" is a live broadcast.
true_false.explanation: Correct. "На живо" means "live".

fill_in_the_blank.name: Elections in October
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Министърът обяви, че изборите __ през октомври.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Министърът обяви, че изборите ще бъдат през октомври." means "The minister announced that the elections would be in October." Reported speech keeps the original tense.

lessons.name: Social Media
lessons.description: Posts, comments and staying safe online.

multiple_choice.name: Match the social media words
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English word to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: On my profile
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Качих снимки от почивката в __ си.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Качих снимки от почивката в профила си." means "I uploaded holiday photos to my profile."

true_false.name: True or false: Haresvam online
true_false.sentence: "Харесвам" can also mean to "like" a post online.
true_false.explanation: Correct. "Хареса ми снимката" means "I liked the photo".

fill_in_the_blank.name: He comments on everything
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Той __ всяка снимка, която публикувам.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Той коментира всяка снимка, която публикувам." means "He comments on every photo I post."

fill_in_the_blank.name: Never share your password
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Моля, никога не __ паролата си с никого!
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Моля, никога не споделяй паролата си с никого!" means "Please never share your password with anyone!" A negative command takes the imperfective.

true_false.name: True or false: Posledovatel
true_false.sentence: A "последовател" on social media is someone who has blocked you.
true_false.explanation: A последовател is a follower.

multiple_choice.name: Match the online verbs
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English phrase to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: An offensive comment
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Изтрих коментара, защото беше много __ и груб.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Изтрих коментара, защото беше много обиден и груб." means "I deleted the comment because it was very offensive and rude." Коментар is masculine.

true_false.name: True or false: Svalyam
true_false.sentence: "Свалям" can mean to download a file.
true_false.explanation: Correct. It literally means "to take down".

fill_in_the_blank.name: If you forget your password
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Ако не __ паролата си, няма да можеш да влезеш.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Ако не помниш паролата си, няма да можеш да влезеш." means "If you do not remember your password, you will not be able to log in."

multiple_choice.name: Match the banking words
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English phrase to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: From the cash machine
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Изтеглих пари от __ на ъгъла.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Изтеглих пари от банкомата на ъгъла." means "I took money out of the cash machine on the corner."

true_false.name: True or false: Lihva
true_false.sentence: "Лихва" is the interest you pay on a loan.
true_false.explanation: Correct. It is also the interest a bank pays on savings.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Open an account
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Искам да __ сметка в тази банка.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Искам да открия сметка в тази банка." means "I want to open an account at this bank."

fill_in_the_blank.name: My salary is paid in
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Заплатата ми се __ по сметката всеки месец.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Заплатата ми се превежда по сметката всеки месец." means "My salary is paid into my account every month."

true_false.name: True or false: Bankomat
true_false.sentence: A "банкомат" is a bank manager.
true_false.explanation: A банкомат is a cash machine.

multiple_choice.name: Match the budget phrases
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English phrase to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: A loan for a car
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Изтеглих __ за нова кола.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Изтеглих кредит за нова кола." means "I took out a loan for a new car."

true_false.name: True or false: Teglya kredit
true_false.sentence: "Тегля кредит" means to take out a loan.
true_false.explanation: Correct. Тегля literally means "to pull" or "to withdraw".

fill_in_the_blank.name: If I spent less
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Ако __ по-малко, щях да имам повече спестявания.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Ако харчех по-малко, щях да имам повече спестявания." means "If I spent less, I would have more savings."

lessons.name: Formal Communication
lessons.description: Official forms, formal letters and polite requests.

multiple_choice.name: Match the official words
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English word to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: An application at the town hall
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Трябва да подам __ в общината.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Трябва да подам заявление в общината." means "I have to submit an application at the town hall."

true_false.name: True or false: Udostoverenie
true_false.sentence: An "удостоверение" is an official certificate.
true_false.explanation: Correct. For example, "удостоверение за раждане" is a birth certificate.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Signed by Friday
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Документите трябва да бъдат __ до петък.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Документите трябва да бъдат подписани до петък." means "The documents must be signed by Friday." Документите is plural.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Could you send me
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Бихте ли __ изпратили копие от договора?
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Бихте ли ми изпратили копие от договора?" means "Could you send me a copy of the contract?"

true_false.name: True or false: Kraen srok
true_false.sentence: "Краен срок" means the start of a project.
true_false.explanation: A краен срок is a deadline, literally "final term".

multiple_choice.name: Match the letter phrases
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English phrase to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: With reference to your letter
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: __ с писмото Ви от 5 май Ви изпращам исканите документи.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Във връзка с писмото Ви от 5 май..." means "With reference to your letter of 5 May, I am sending you the documents requested."

true_false.name: True or false: Molba
true_false.sentence: A "молба" is a formal request or application.
true_false.explanation: Correct. It comes from моля, "to ask".

fill_in_the_blank.name: If you reply by the end of the week
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Ще Ви бъда благодарен, ако ми __ до края на седмицата.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Ще Ви бъда благодарен, ако ми отговорите до края на седмицата." means "I would be grateful if you could reply by the end of the week."
